title: gray thumbnail slot background
description:
The library row's thumbnail slot (ClipThumbnail in FileListRow.kt)
letterboxed the ratio-true icon over surfaceVariant, which rides the
NeutralVariant palette — under dynamic color that palette carries the
wallpaper's hue, so the slot's background tinted itself with whatever
Monet tone the wallpaper produced instead of reading as plain gray.

Swap the slot's background to surfaceContainerHighest, which rides the
NEUTRAL palette: chroma-free in both modes, so the letterbox area is a
plain gray in light AND dark. The tone is a like-for-like swap in
light mode (M3 maps light surfaceVariant to NeutralVariant90 and
surfaceContainerHighest to Neutral90 — same lightness, hue removed);
dark mode drops from NV30 to N22, still a clearly visible step above
the dark surface. The app's own neutral editor scheme already proves
this container family reads gray (0xFF3b3b3b).

Scope: the rounded slot's b
changed: fix: gray thumbnail slot letterbox bg
